title: Video: One Year With The Trek CheckOUT – Travis Engel
content:
The Trek CheckOUT full-suspension gravel bike has been out for a year now. Travis reviewed one at launch, but he still hasn’t given it back. So, he got on camera to share what he’s learned in the past twelve months. Hopefully it’ll get people riled up about it again.

Normally, I keep a review bike for about five or six weeks before sending it back to the brand. But I talked Trek into letting me hold onto the CheckOUT full-suspension gravel bike for a year. Partly because I wanted to see what kind of nonsense we might get up to, and partly because I just really really like it. Now that the year has come to an end, I’m a little emotional. I’m grateful for the experiences I’ve had on this bike, but I’m grieving that doesn’t seem to have spawned the revolution I hoped it would.

The review I wrote in September of 2025 goes into all the bike’s facts and figures, plus an account of a five-day trans-Rockies I took it on. It’s the best place to start if you’re looking for the “what,” “how,” and “why” behind the CheckOUT. But I wanted to put a more personal touch on my final thoughts on the CheckOUT. So, I decided to stand in front of a camera, and slightly diagonal to another camera, and pour my heart out about this weird machine.
